ev.q: The number of vaccine-related poliovirus isolates declined from 47 (8.2%) in 1997 to 19 (2.3%) in 1998, to three (0.8%) in 1999.
The number of states reporting enterovirus isolations declined from 14 in 1997 to eight in 1999.
echovirus 30 was the predominant serotype and accounted for 27.5% of all isolates
Children aged <1 year accounted for 45% of all reported enterovirus isolates.
The proportion of less common serotypes declined from 17.8% during 1993--1996 ( 4 ) to 6.3% during 1997--1999.
This report summarizes data from the National Enterovirus Surveillance System (NESS)
describes temporal trends of reported enterovirus infections in the United States during 1997--1999.
